label: Dispatch No. 1

letter.title: Welcome to the Library
body: You’ll find stories, opinions, confessions, curious discoveries and the occasional rather mischievous invitation. Please feel free to open anything that interests you. The books have been quiet for quite long enough.

This is the first Dispatch, so a word on how things work here. Each month I shelve a handful of new books. Some will make you laugh somewhere you shouldn’t. One may make you cross, which is healthy. None of them will tell you how to become a better version of yourself. You are quite good enough as a first edition.

This month’s theme is Say Her Name. You’ll meet a woman who has held a wreath for a hundred and thirty-nine years, and another whose library carries her husband’s name. Say theirs. Then say your own, out loud, somewhere it isn’t expected.
Next time you’re tempted to doomscroll, come here instead. Your thumb deserves better.
letter.ps: P.S. If a book seems to be watching you, it probably is. Carry on.

cabinet.teaserTitle: From the History · Case File No. 001
cabinet.teaser: The library that inspired ours was built by a woman. It bears her husband’s name. The History has been digging. (He’s a man. He’s allowed in by special permission, and we make him do all the graft. He loves it.)
